system.description:
You create a maw of wind that roars pushing back all in its path. Creatures in range must make a Strength saving throw being pushed back 30 feet, taking 4d8 wind damage and suffering 1 rank of Bleed on a failed save. On a successful save, creatures take half as much damage and no additional effects. If a creature knocked back by this jutsu collides with a solid object, their movement is stopped, taking the damage they would have taken as if they had fallen an equal distance.

Critical Success: Affected creatures take half of 4d8 wind damage.

Success: Affected creatures take half of 4d8 wind damage and are Shaken until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures take 4d8 wind damage, are pushed back 30 feet and gain 1 rank of Bleed. If a creature knocked back by this jutsu collides with a solid object, their movement is stopped, taking the damage they would have taken as if they had fallen an equal distance.

Critical Failure: Same as Failure, but affected creature takes 6d8 wind damage and gain 2 ranks of Bleed.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above C-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3 and increase the damage by 1d8. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher creatures can spend their reaction to plant themselves. If they don’t they make their saving throw with a -2 penalty to their saving throw.
